{
  "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically too high - true prices consistently lag behind and are 1-3 euros lower than model predictions",
    "The gap between model and reality increases with forecast horizon - 30th day differences exceed 3-4 euros compared to 5-10 euro gaps at day 10",
    "True prices exhibit strong mean reversion away from historical averages, which the model fails to capture",
    "Sentiment signals have delayed and dampened effect - high sentiment (1.0) correlates with only 0.2-0.3 price increases relative to forecast expectations",
    "Model over-optimistically assumes sentiment momentum persists, but true prices show sentiment effects quickly fade and reverse",
    "Price levels in examples 1-3 consistently drift lower than modeled, suggesting a structural bias the model doesn't account for",
    "Sentiment alignment in model forecasts is overly linear - real prices show non-linear responses where extreme sentiment changes have diminishing price effects"
  ]
}
